Pole star: Polaris, {0}° from the pole.

Two things change. Each star moves through space (Hipparcos motions), so near stars drift: the Big Dipper bends out of shape. And Earth's axis slowly circles (precession, one turn in about {0} years), so the pole star changes and different stars rise where you live.
Planets, the Moon and today's targets are hidden. Simple precession model: good to a few degrees.
